items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson not spotted at Friday practice (third straight DNP this week after left ankle sprain Oct 4); Tyler Huntley expected to start second straight week.
items.why: Missed all practices this week; hasn't suited since Titans game.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens have averaged 33.7 PPG in his recent fill-in wins.
items.opportunity: Continue elevated usage for Flowers/Henry/Andrews under Huntley if Lamar sits.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) again for Sunday vs Patriots, along with WR Adonai Mitchell (finger).
items.why: Quad injury; no practice, ruled out for third straight potential miss.
items.implication: Braelon Allen continues as lead back with high snap share.
items.opportunity: Near-full backfield snaps/carries to Allen (90% in recent full games without Hall per Levitan).

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Sunday vs Panthers (and indefinitely) after follow-up ultrasound showed movement in superficial blood clot in calf; Tanner McKee will start while treatment course determined.
items.why: Clot movement detected Wednesday night; health priority, possible blood thinners preventing play.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense shift to pocket passer, potential volume changes for pass-catchers and reduced tush-push/goal-line QB runs.
items.opportunity: Backup QB snaps fully to McKee; monitor DeVonta Smith/Goedert/Barkley roles under new QB.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley no practice again Thursday; DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited.
items.implication: Barkley status for Sunday uncertain amid Hurts absence; Smith trending up.
items.opportunity: If Barkley limited/out, more work for Gainwell or committee; Smith routes/targets available.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee) and S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and are ruled OUT vs Jaguars.
items.implication: Backfield snaps open fully for remaining RBs (e.g. Marks/others).
items.opportunity: Full opportunity for Houston RB committee without Montgomery.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start Sunday vs Falcons.
items.implication: Williams starts; Bears pass catchers (Moore/Odunze/Burden) regain primary QB.
items.opportunity: Normal snap/route shares restored under Williams.

items.text: RB snaps in two full games since Breece Hall injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0.
items.implication: Allen is clear lead back/handcuff beneficiary with near-monopoly on snaps while Hall out.
items.opportunity: 90%+ snap/carry share to Allen; high weekly floor if Hall remains out.

items.text: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins/McNabb/McCoy/Ertz); Saquon Barkley turns 30 in February—if Super Bowl contender with RB need, at least call. Agrees risk of too-early better than too-late in this case.
items.why: Age/precedent for Eagles trading stars before decline; current injury context.
items.implication: ROS/trade value caution for Barkley owners; potential landing spot boost if moved.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; Evans is Berry's WR4 for Week 6.
items.why: Washington defense nightmare for WRs; strong matchup.
items.implication: Start with high confidence as WR1/2.

items.text: LOVE Drake London vs CHI; ranked WR6 in Berry Week 6.
LOVE Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5); elite recent usage vs run-leaking defense.
items.why: Volume elite lately; ARI soft vs run.

items.text: LOVE Javonte Williams @ GB (RB8); volume and goal-line role.
items.why: Workload + near-goal-line work vs leaky run D.

items.text: HATE Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28); tough matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Seattle problem secondary + shaky QB situation; also dealt with shoulder Q in TNF but returned.
items.conflict: Returned ACTIVE in TNF after Q.

items.text: LOVE Brock Purdy vs WSH (QB2); high-scoring environment vs pass-vulnerable defense.
items.why: Commanders can't slow pass; big game total potential with Kittle/etc.
